name: mantic-mcp
description: Mantic MCP server for interactive AI forecasts: search questions, view forecasts, render CDF charts, and explain what drives a forecast.

interface.shortDescription: Search, view and explain Mantic's AI forecasts.
interface.longDescription: Find Mantic forecasts on geopolitics, business, policy, markets, technology and culture, read the latest probabilities and CDF charts, and get a forecast explained: what Mantic predicts, why, how it has moved, and what would change it.
defaultPrompt: What does Mantic forecast for the next Fed rate decision?
Show me the questions on my Mantic dashboard.
Explain why Mantic's forecast on this question changed.
